name: Corrupted Wolf
languages: understands Common and Abyssal but can't speak
description: Within the Blighted Thornbriar Grove, the Corrupted Wolf prowls as a grim sentinel of Malarok's dark influence. Once a noble creature of the wild, it now bears the unmistakable mark of the Voidstone's taint. Its fur, once a vibrant gray, is mottled with sickly black and deep crimson streaks, as if the shadows themselves have seeped into its very flesh. Jagged patches of bark-like growth sprout along its flanks, pulsing faintly with veins of corrupted dark energy that writhe beneath a cracked, bark-textured skin. Its eyes burn with an unnatural, phosphorescent red glow, piercing the gloom of the twisted grove with a malevolent intelligence. The beast moves with unnatural grace, muscles tense beneath its corrupted pelt, exuding a low growl that reverberates through the thick, poisoned air. The wolf's breath mists with a faint black smoke, and the ground beneath its paws seems to wither and blacken, leaves curling into ash where it treads. Fiercely protective, this creature serves as the dark guardian of the fallen dryad Sylara, attacking with savage ferocity anyone who dares threaten its mistress or the corrupted land it haunts. In the oppressive silence of the thornbriar maze, the Corrupted Wolf is both a symbol of lost beauty and a harbinger of relentless decay, its presence a chilling reminder of nature twisted by malevolent sorcery.
